messages:
Maya (sec-eng): Quick heads-up — ACME pen-test kickoff is next Wed (03:00-07:00 UTC). Need to lock down intake, evidence packaging, and retest windows. Who can own RBAC temporary roles and KMS access?
Jon (infra): I can own ephemeral RBAC roles. Plan to use short-lived SSH and IAM roles via our access-proxy. Need exact list of principals the assessors need.
Maya (sec-eng): Assessor emails already in the intake doc. They need read access to logs, ability to fetch object store evidence, and a read-only handle to KMS-wrapped secrets for validation. No write to production services.
Sam (sre): For audit logs: we'll create a dedicated export stream to the pen-test S3 prefix and enable increased retention for the window. Will need to whitelist assessor IPs for access.
Eva (platform): For KMS we can create a one-time asymmetric wrapping key and rotate it after the window. Is that sufficient or do they need decrypt?
Maya (sec-eng): They only need to verify key wrapping and key usage patterns, not decrypt application secrets. So asymmetric wrapping + pre-signed evidence artifacts is fine.
David (product): For remediation tracking, let's use the pen-test board in Jira: PT-BOARD. Each vuln should have an owner, severity, and target fix date. Can we automate a webhook from Jira -> #incidents on big sev changes?
Ops-bot: Created JIRA board PT-ACME and generated webhook token (hidden). Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/boards/PT-ACME
Jon (infra): RBAC blueprint (draft):
```
- Create role: pen-test-assessor
- Policies: logs:read, s3:List/Get on pen-test prefix, kms:DescribeKey, kms:Encrypt (wrap only)
- Session duration: 1h, max 4h with approval
```
Maya (sec-eng): Approvals: use approver group sec-oncall + eng-sre. We'll log approvals in the evidence bundle.
Sam (sre): On staging we should run a dry-run on Monday to validate access windows + log exports. Who can join dry-run 14:00 UTC Mon?
Eva (platform): I can join. I'll validate KMS wrapping key and that the pre-signed evidence links expire.
Jon (infra): I'll provision the ephemeral roles Monday morning and attach a policy that expires with a tag.
David (product): I'll coordinate with the assessors on evidence expectations and confirm load for the retest window (we may need a 2h follow-up retest).
Maya (sec-eng): Retest window proposal: two 2-hour slots the following week (Mon and Thu 03:00-05:00 UTC). We should allow a 24h buffer for fixes and verification.
Sam (sre): Noted — I'll reserve the monitoring runbooks and schedule an on-call rotation for those windows.
Maya (sec-eng): Deliverables checklist for the pen-test intake:
- RBAC ephemeral roles created and documented (owner: Jon)
- KMS wrapping key + rotation plan (owner: Eva)
- Audit export stream to S3 with retention policy (owner: Sam)
- Jira board + webhook (owner: David)
- Dry-run Monday 14:00 UTC (participants: Jon, Eva, Sam, Maya)
- Evidence packaging template (I'll upload to the intake doc)

Jon (infra): Quick note on evidence packaging: please include timestamps + SHA256 of archives and a README mapping artifacts to resources. We'll need that for repro.
Maya (sec-eng): Yep — adding that to the intake doc now. Link: https://docs.internal/redwood/pt/acme-intake (private)
David (product): Anything blocking approvals from legal/compliance?
Maya (sec-eng): Legal signed off on the scope yesterday. Compliance wants audit log retention increased to 90 days for the exported prefix — Sam, can you confirm?
Sam (sre): Can do 90 days for the exported prefix. Will add lifecycle rule and notify ops-team.
Eva (platform): One last KMS detail: we'll restrict key usage to the pen-test service account and policy will explicitly deny decrypt. Confirm?
Maya (sec-eng): Confirm — deny decrypt. Allow Describe/Encrypt/GenerateDataKey for wrapping flows only.
pen-test-bot: Pen-test intake doc updated and dry-run event added to calendar: Mon 14:00 UTC. Attendees: Maya, Jon, Sam, Eva.
Maya (sec-eng): Perfect. I'll follow up with a short remediation triage cadence: daily standups during the fix sprint and handoff meeting 24h before retest. Thanks all :thumbsup:
David (product): Thanks — I'll start the Jira tickets and ping the assessors about retest preferences.
Maya (sec-eng): Closing action: owners noted above, I'll post the final runbook by EOD today.
